description:
Markdown-based note-taking app for developers


Znote 4.9.3
Bug fixes
- Windows: shell code blocks run again. Since 4.8.1, powershell, pwsh and cmd blocks failed on Windows before running any code, with an error saying chcp could not be found. Znote was passing a broken PATH to the script, so C:\Windows\System32 could no longer be found. The original PATH is now kept.
- Windows: emojis and accented characters in PowerShell blocks display correctly. Windows PowerShell 5.1 misread non-ASCII characters in a block, so 👋 was printed as ðŸ‘‹. Znote now saves the script in a format PowerShell reads correctly.
